guideTitle: The Best Office Chairs with Flip-Up Arms for Tucking Under a Desk
breadcrumbLabel: Best Office Chairs with Flip-Up Arms
metaTitle: Best Office Chairs with Flip-Up Arms (2026)
metaDescription: Flip-up arms let a chair slide under a desk or out of the way. We compared eight chairs and flag which listings actually confirm flip-up armrests.
introParagraphs: Flip-up armrests rotate up out of the way, so a chair can slide fully under a desk, let you sit closer to the edge, or leave room to move. They're useful in small rooms and at desks with low aprons.

Only four chairs here confirm flip-up arms in their listings (the executive chair, Primy drafting chair and two NEO CHAIR models). The Marsail has 3D arms that aren't confirmed to flip, and three others don't specify arm style, so check before buying if this feature is the reason you're shopping.
Most listings here don't give seat dimensions or weight ratings. Our comparison is based on published specifications, not hands-on testing.

leather-flip-up-executive-chair.badge: Best Executive Chair with Flip-Up Arms
leather-flip-up-executive-chair.summary: A PU leather seat, mesh back chair with flip-up arms and adjustable lumbar support.
leather-flip-up-executive-chair.description:
This executive-style task chair has flip-up armrests confirmed in its listing, a PU leather seat with a mesh back and adjustable lumbar support, on a swivel base.

The brand isn't named in the listing, and seat dimensions and weight rating aren't given in the summary.
leather-flip-up-executive-chair.bestFor: A tidy office where the chair should tuck under the desk.
leather-flip-up-executive-chair.skipIf: You need a tall chair; the Primy is a drafting chair.

primy-drafting-flip-up-chair.badge: Best for Standing Desks and Counters
primy-drafting-flip-up-chair.summary: A tall drafting chair with flip-up arms and an adjustable footrest ring.
primy-drafting-flip-up-chair.description:
The Primy is a tall drafting chair with flip-up armrests, a footrest ring you can adjust and lumbar support, suited to standing desks at a raised height, counters or drafting tables.

The listing summary doesn't give its exact height range; check it against your work surface.
primy-drafting-flip-up-chair.bestFor: Sitting at a raised standing desk or counter.
primy-drafting-flip-up-chair.skipIf: Your desk is standard height; a regular task chair fits better.

marsail-3d-armrest-chair.summary: A high-back mesh chair with 3D armrests, adjustable lumbar and headrest; flip-up not confirmed.
marsail-3d-armrest-chair.description:
The Marsail has 3D armrests that move up and down, forward and back, and pivot, plus a high mesh back, adjustable lumbar and a headrest.

Its listing doesn't confirm flip-up arms. Lowering 3D arms may clear some desks, but if flip-up is essential, choose a chair that confirms it.
specs: Arms: 3D (height, depth, pivot); flip-up not confirmed
marsail-3d-armrest-chair.bestFor: Adjustable arms and a headrest, if flip-up isn't essential.
marsail-3d-armrest-chair.skipIf: Flip-up is essential; the NEO CHAIR models confirm it.

neochair-pink-flip-up.summary: A pink mesh NEO CHAIR with flip-up arms, adjustable height and lumbar support.
neochair-pink-flip-up.description:
The NEO CHAIR in pink is a low-cost mesh chair with confirmed flip-up arms, adjustable height, lumbar support and swivel casters, at under $60 at the time of writing.

Its listing summary doesn't give seat dimensions or a weight rating.
neochair-pink-flip-up.bestFor: A small home office on a budget.
neochair-pink-flip-up.skipIf: You want black; the other NEO listing is similar.

neochair-black-flip-up.summary: A black high-back mesh NEO CHAIR with flip-up arms and lumbar support.
neochair-black-flip-up.description:
This NEO CHAIR has a high mesh back, confirmed flip-up armrests, lumbar support, adjustable height and rolling casters, at about the same price as the pink model at the time of writing.

It's close to a duplicate of the pink chair; choose by color and back height.
neochair-black-flip-up.skipIf: You want the lowest price with confirmed flip-up; either NEO chair works.

neochair-midback-no-arm-detail.summary: A mid-back mesh NEO CHAIR; the listing doesn't say whether the arms flip up.
neochair-midback-no-arm-detail.description:
This mid-back NEO CHAIR is the lowest-priced chair here, with a mesh back, adjustable height and swivel casters.

The listing doesn't specify the arm style, so it may not have flip-up arms; check photos and details before buying for that feature.
neochair-midback-no-arm-detail.bestFor: A basic chair where flip-up arms are optional.
neochair-midback-no-arm-detail.skipIf: Flip-up is essential; the other NEO chairs confirm it.

bestoffice-midback-no-arm-detail.summary: A BestOffice mid-back chair with breathable back, lumbar support and sponge seat; arm style not specified.
bestoffice-midback-no-arm-detail.description:
The BestOffice is a low-cost mid-back chair with a breathable backrest, lumbar support, adjustable height and a sponge seat.

Its listing doesn't specify whether the arms flip up.
bestoffice-midback-no-arm-detail.bestFor: A basic chair where flip-up arms are optional.
bestoffice-midback-no-arm-detail.skipIf: Flip-up is essential; choose a confirmed model.

furmax-executive-no-arm-detail.summary: A Furmax high-back PU leather executive chair; arm style not specified.
furmax-executive-no-arm-detail.description:
The Furmax is a high-back PU leather executive chair with lumbar support, adjustable height and a swivel base.

Its listing doesn't specify flip-up arms, so it may not tuck under a desk.
furmax-executive-no-arm-detail.bestFor: An executive look where flip-up isn't essential.
furmax-executive-no-arm-detail.skipIf: Flip-up matters; the executive chair at #1 confirms it.

bottomLine: For confirmed flip-up arms on a budget, the NEO CHAIR models are the simplest choice, and the executive chair adds adjustable lumbar and a leather-look seat. For a standing desk or counter, the Primy drafting chair is the tall option.
The Marsail offers the most adjustable arms but doesn't confirm flip-up; the remaining chairs don't specify arm style.
